title: BHARAT MAPS Transport Infrastructure — Assam Revenue Circles
description: Length of road and rail networks per Revenue Circle in Assam, sourced from the BHARAT MAPS GIS service, used as a lifeline-infrastructure exposure input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Transport infrastructure exposure covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: This is a snapshot as of September 2023, not a time series. License confirmed as 'CC BY 4.0' per the risk model's data dictionary. Note: that dictionary classifies road_length and rail_length under its own 'Vulnerability' pillar (not 'Exposure') — see the crosswalk note in Sources/BHARATMAPS/metadata/rdls-buildings.json for why RDLS's 'exposure' type is still used here. Health centres and schools from the same source are catalogued separately in Sources/BHARATMAPS/metadata/rdls-buildings.json.

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.
